title: Contact
subtitle: How to reach The Utah View.
body:
We read everything that comes in. The fastest way to reach The Utah View is by email.

General questions and feedback

Email theutahview@gmail.com. We aim to reply within a few days.

Corrections

If you spot an error in a story, use the Report an error link at the bottom of the article, or email us with the story’s title and what needs fixing. Our corrections policy is on the Methodology page.

App help

For problems with the iPhone, iPad or Android app, email us with your device and what happened. You can delete your account at any time in the app under More → Delete account, or on the web at theutahview.com/delete-account.html.

Privacy

See our Privacy Policy, or email the address above.

The Utah View · Salt Lake City, Utah
